data.title: 椎名真由理 · 老钟表行廊下的金怀表祈愿
data.description: 下町老钟表铺斑驳木檐下，古老挂钟滴答作响。真由理双手将金色的老怀表轻贴在心口，闭上双眼虔诚祈祷伙伴们都能平安，神情圣洁柔和。
data.location: vintage clock repair shop eaves with antique wall clocks ticking quietly in background
data.action: clasping antique gold pocket watch against chest with both hands, closed eyes in gentle earnest prayer, soft peaceful smile
data.lighting: 檐下柔和天光与橱窗微光
data.promptProse: Mayuri presses an antique gold pocket watch against her heart outside a quiet clockmaker shop, eyes closed in heartfelt, tender prayer.
data.animaCaption: Soft natural light falls across her folded hands cradling the gold pocket watch.
